_comment: Game rules of the server module. office: office id on the presence codes and its time zone (days, streaks and fines follow office time). attendance.fine_tiers: the n-th workday missed in a row costs `percent` of the balance, rounded up, never below zero; the first missed day only breaks the streak. photo.partner_bonus: coins the colleague gets for confirming a joint photo. raffle: parking draw on the last Friday of every month. avatar_templates: ready-made profile pictures (client AvatarCatalog.TEMPLATES).

raffle.prize_description: Крытый тёплый паркинг под офисом на весь следующий месяц.
